summary: BRATTEBØHEIA SANKELAG SA (org. no. 985 950 857) is a cooperative (SA) based in Bjerkreim, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2003-12-03. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 01.620 (Tjenester tilknyttet husdyrhold); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Ketil Gjedrem.
